about: Where each layer's leader line starts in sitegen/templates/hero-scene.svg, in scene units (the SVG's own coordinates): the right corner of the layer's plate at half its thickness. The viewBox starts at x = -28 to make room for the person who stands on the ground left of the board, so a position across the drawing is x minus that origin. Layers are numbered as the stack's codes, T1 (the board) to T7. label_y sets a label higher than its anchor: the board sits below the 56-unit rhythm of the plates, so its leader elbows up to its label.
